statement: SDL Triton initializes a Puck receiver interface without marking it as a connected joystick. On a connect state change it adds a joystick through the HIDAPI device context, while disconnect removes that context's joystick. The driver reads and sends output through its own selected HID device, not a shared player-number mapping.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
